header.running_head: The Freed slave of Rasulullaah ﷺ Called Hadhrat Safeena (RA) Carries the Goods of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: (RA) about his name. He replied, "I shall inform you about my name. It was Rasulullaah ﷺ who gave me the name Safeena (ship)." "But why did Rasulullaah ﷺ call you Safeena?" Hadhrat Sa'eed asked. Hadhrat Safeena (RA) replied, "Rasulullaah ﷺ once left on a journey with his Sahabah (RA). When their goods became too heavy for them, Rasulullaah ﷺ said (to me), 'Spread out your shawl'. When I spread it out, Rasulullaah ﷺ tied up all the goods in it and placed it on me, saying, 'Carry this for you are Safeena (a ship).' Had Rasulullaah ﷺ loaded on me the load of not only one or two but five camels, it would not have been heavy for me."[^1]
The Incidents of Hadhrat Ahmar (RA) the Freed Slave of Hadhrat Ummu Salma (RA) and Mujaahid with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)

Hadhrat Ahmar (RA) who was the freed slave of Hadhrat Ummu Salma (RA) narrates that they were travelling with Rasulullaah ﷺ on an expedition when they passed by a stream. As Hadhrat Ahmar (RA) started transporting people across the stream, Rasulullaah ﷺ commented, "You are certainly a Safeena (a ship) today."[^2]

Hadhrat Mujaahid (RAH) narrates, "I used to accompany Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) on his journeys. Whenever I would mount my animal, he would come and hold the stirrup and whenever I got on to the animal, he would put my clothes right. When he came to me once (to give me the same service) I expressed my annoyance. He then said, 'O Mujaahid! You have a very straitened personality.'"[^3]
Fasting While out in the path of Allaah
Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) Fast During Extreme Heat While Out in the path of Allaah

Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) says, "I saw us on some journeys with Rasulullaah ﷺ during such extreme heat that people would place their hands over their heads because of the severity of the heat. None would be fasting then besides Rasulullaah ﷺ himself and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA)."[^4] Another narration states that this was during the month of Ramadhaan.

Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) says, "We went on expeditions with Rasulullaah ﷺ during the month of Ramadhaan. Whilst some of us fasted, others did not. Neither would the fasting ones get upset with the non-fasting ones, nor would the non-fasting ones get upset with the fasting ones. Each one thought that if someone had the strength, he would fast and that was best for
Hasan bin Sufyaan, Ibn Mandah, Maalini and Abu Nu'aym, as quoted in Muntakhab (Vol.5 Pg.194).
